messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — starting a config-only rollout now for routing weight tweaks, per-tenant tinybatch, and a 250ms tail timeout. This is a canary at 3% for 20m. Please watch latencies and error rates.

deploy-bot: deploybot: canary started (config-only) env=prod scope=tenant-weighting change_id=cfg-2026-03-21-01 target=3% duration=20m

ajay: noted. I’ll watch p50/p95 and the per-route dashboards. tagging @sophie for business-critical tenants.

sophie: thanks — I’ll keep an eye on customer-facing routes (checkout/chat). Can you paste the exact config so I can diff against current?

maria: sure — snippet below. It’s just routing weights + batching window + tail timeout. No model changes.

maria: ```json
{"routing": {"default_weight": 0.85, "overflow_weight": 0.15}, "batching": {"max_batch_ms": 12, "tinybatch_threshold": 4}, "timeouts": {"tail_ms": 250}}
```

kevin: quick question — are we pinning any model versions for the overflow path? I want to avoid surprise model swaps if fallback kicks in.

maria: no pin, overflow will go to the same model family but with fallback capacity. If we see >1% errors we’ll pin overflow to stable-v2 and revert routing weight.

ops-bot: alert: no immediate anomaly detected in first 5m. p50=28ms p95=142ms overall.

ajay: p95 on checkout is +10ms vs baseline but error rate unchanged. looks fine so far.

sophie: FYI support is queued for a quick watch for the next 40m. If anything customer-facing, call for rollback.

maria: plan if symptoms show: 1) reduce canary to 1% 2) increase tail timeout back to 400ms 3) if still bad, rollback config-change id cfg-2026-03-21-01. Everyone ok with that?

kevin: +1. Also add a short-lived pin to stable-v2 in the rollback play (so overflow doesn't trigger newer variants).

ajay: +1. I’ll prepare the quick rollback command and keep it ready: `deploy-bot rollback --change cfg-2026-03-21-01 --to=previous --force`

maria: perfect. tagging the deploybot runbook link: https://runbook.internal/release/config-rollouts (follow the checklist under "tiny-canary").

deploy-bot: note: will automatically scale down canary to 1% if p95 breach > 200ms for 5m, and will notify channel. Manual rollback still preferred for customer-facing impact.

sophie: thanks — stand by. I’ll escalate to SRE pager if we see anything >0.5% customer error or visible checkout slowdowns.

maria: thanks all — leaving monitoring in your hands. I’ll post a final status when canary completes (20m). :eyes:
